form.label: CCDC | Ubuntu Email
form.description: Ubuntu 22.04 Email at 172.20.240.15. Check Postfix/Dovecot actual mail logs.

input.label: Select indexed hostname for this VM

search.query: index=* earliest=-24h | stats count by host | fields host | sort host
index=* host="$selected_host$" | stats count by host,source,sourcetype | sort -count
index=* host="$selected_host$" ("Accepted password" OR "Accepted publickey" OR "Failed password" OR "Invalid user") | table _time host source _raw | sort -_time
index=* host="$selected_host$" ("sudo:" OR "useradd" OR "usermod" OR "userdel" OR "groupadd") | table _time host source _raw | sort -_time
index=* host="$selected_host$" (source="*/mail.log" OR source="*/maillog") | stats count by source,host | sort -count

index=* host="$selected_host$" (source="*/mail.log" OR source="*/maillog") ("auth failed" OR "authentication failed" OR "SASL LOGIN authentication failed") | table _time host source _raw | sort -_time
